verses.t: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance
verses.yusufAli: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance)
verses.rodwell: TRULY we have given thee an ABUNDANCE
verses.sale: Verily we have given thee al Cawthar

verses.t: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]
verses.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice
verses.yusufAli: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice
verses.rodwell: Pray therefore to the Lord, and slay the victims
verses.sale: Wherefore pray unto thy Lord, and slay the victims

verses.t: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity
verses.yusufAli: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope)
verses.rodwell: Verily whose hateth thee shall be childless
verses.sale: verily he who hateth thee shall be childless
